claims.head: Strength vs. Strength
claims.body: The Golden Knights are one of the league’s best for chance quality, but the Senators are one of the best at preventing dangerous shots. Hot take: the Golden Knights break through anyway.
claims.call: The Golden Knights’ chances are more dangerous than the league average (a 6.3% chance of scoring on the average shot) against the Senators.

claims.head: Stützle gets company tonight
claims.call: The Golden Knights’ L3 (Howden, Karlsson and Holtz) spends at least 49% of its 5-on-5 time against the Senators’ first line, against about 39% with no line matching.
claims.body: At home, the Golden Knights keep sending Karlsson’s line (Howden, Karlsson and Holtz) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Ryan Craig has been using this group as a checking line on the other team’s top line. Tonight the Senators’ first line is Zetterlund, Giroux and Stützle.

claims.gist: At home, Ryan Craig likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Senators’ first line.

notes.text: The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 10 games cover only 16% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the lowest share in the league (a typical team: 44%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Jordan Spence has started killing penalties: on the ice for 31% of the team’s shorthanded time in 12 games, up from 4% last season.

stakes: The Senators go in tied for second in the Atlantic with 16 points, the Golden Knights second in the Pacific with 17 points.

VGK.head: The Golden Knights have a lot going for them
VGK.body: Vegas has been out-chancing opponents lately and has home-ice advantage. The Senators can make it interesting if they get good looks.

OTT.head: The Senators face a real test
OTT.body: Vegas has been out-chancing opponents lately and has home-ice advantage. The Senators’ best way through is getting good looks.

story.head: Strength vs. Strength
paras: The Golden Knights are winless in three (0-2-1). The Senators are 8-4-0.

It’s strength against strength: the Golden Knights are one of the league’s best for chance quality, but the Senators are one of the best at preventing dangerous shots. At home, Ryan Craig likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Sens’ first line.

items.text: The Senators are newly without Linus Ullmark, and have been without Thomas Chabot and William Eklund for several games. Jonas Johansson is expected to start.
Mitch Marner has missed the Golden Knights’ last two games.
Drake Batherson has four goals in six games against Vegas since 2023-24.
Tim Stützle has a point in four straight games, with a goal in each of the last three.
